name: security

findings.message: _runner_run_id read from the persisted state file via get_state_field is never sanitised before being interpolated into event-bus fields; a crafted state file whose .run_id contains spaces or equals signs would split the event record into extra phantom fields.

In _runner_from_stage_preflight the variable name built for indirect expansion uses only dash-to-underscore substitution, leaving characters such as ], [, and . intact; bash interprets arrayname[n] syntax inside indirect expansion, so a cycle name containing ] could resolve to a different array element than intended.

export _ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=true makes the engine internal resume flag visible to every child process including plugin run hooks; a plugin that reads this variable can silently alter its behaviour on resume, creating an undocumented side-channel between the engine and plugin code.

The guard in _artifact_persist_put_back rejects absolute rel values but does not reject rel paths beginning with ../; a directory containing a symlink whose find output after prefix-stripping starts with .. could bypass the check and write outside the destination tree.

reason: the security lens found no medium or high or critical problem the change introduced that fails it
